run.command: strata bench run --profile launch-iq3_s-200k --track custom --track-notes custom track: machine-calibrated setup (expert-profile.bin + --prefill-pipe 1536); DFlash2 drafter (--draft dflash2, q4_0-selq4 pack + selector, --spec 6 --draft-conf 0.35, --draft-fallback none), serial drafter, server capacity 1 slot; experimental speed projection ON (refusal-direction control vector: --control-vector-scaled ...speed-projection.gguf:1.0 --control-vector-layer-range 4 44 --cvec-mode project --cvec-dir per-layer); vision ON (mmproj BF16); 2x RTX 3090 layer_split auto; --kv int8 --kv-resident 32768; 200K context; engine 0.1.62-windows-x86_64-cuda-cuda13 from the component store, Control/CLI 0.2.16 --model-revision ed59f92082b1e93c0e96d60a8b11aab089b52f09 --quantization IQ3_S --custom-pack prepared pack Strata-data/packs/iq3_s; DFlash2 drafter pack Strata-data/dflash2 (auto-fetched by the 0.2.16 CLI, SHA-pinned); MTP pack retained for draft_vocab.bin only; model files Strata-data/models/IQ3_S (Strata's default model dir, SHA-256 verified at pinned revision) --background Windows 11 Hyper-V host; Ubuntu Server + Talos VMs running at near-idle load (not stopped for this run); ~95 GB RAM free; otherwise idle desktop --optional-concurrency --load-timeout 3600
